hourly.summary: United crashed to a 2-0 defeat at Atletico Madrid courtesy of a 49-second Barrios strike and a Yoro red card, extending their winless run to five games and leaving Carrick clinging to the wheel. Lisandro Martinez went full nuclear on the hierarchy post-match, demanding investment and calling out the 'bang-average' recruitment, while the never-beaten-Atleti hoodoo continues to haunt the Theatre of Nightmares.

daily.summary: Manchester United fan sentiment remains entrenched in severe negativity throughout the day, with both summaries scoring 3/10 and describing systemic failure across the club. The later 'Crisis' summary expands blame to the board, entire coaching staff, and multiple players, while the earlier 'Fuming' summary focuses on Bruno Fernandes, Carrick's management, and physical decline — together painting a picture of rudderless incompetence and eroding trust.

weekly.summary: The week began with fragile optimism during the international break but rapidly deteriorated after a shocking opening-day loss to Hull City, triggering a sustained downward spiral. A brief moment of cautious stability mid-week evaporated as a worsening injury crisis and a disastrous 1-1 home draw against 10-man Tottenham extended United's worst start in 40 years, culminating in open revolt with 'Carrick Out' chants and total loss of faith in the project. The dominant arc is a collapse from uneasy hope into full-blown crisis, with only academy graduates providing any respite from the gloom.
